en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with decorative lilies-of-the-valley framing three photographic views of medieval monastery ruins. The left view shows an arched stone gate labeled "TOR". The central view shows a gabled ruin behind a long stone wall labeled "GIEBEL". The right view depicts a small ruined chapel with tall arched windows labeled "KAPELLE D. HEIL. 3. KÖNIGE." Beneath the central image a banner reads "RUINEN DES KLOSTERS ALT-ZELLA BEI NOSSEN." On the lower right margin, printed vertically in red, is "Handkolorirte Künstlerkarte."
